data.title: Car insurance policy (Kfz-Haftpflicht and Teilkasko)
data.summary: Beispiel Direktversicherung AG sent the policy for your car liability and partial cover insurance, starting 15 March 2027. The annual premium is €486.20, debited in advance.
data.explanation: This is your insurance certificate (Versicherungsschein) for the Beispiel Kombi 1.5. Cover starts on 15 March 2027 and includes liability and partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) with a €150 excess. The contract runs one year and renews automatically for another year unless you cancel in writing or text form at least one month before the end of an insurance year. The annual premium is debited from your account when cover starts, so make sure the account has enough funds. The app shows the cancellation deadline.
data.tax_note: Car liability insurance contributions can be deductible as insurance expenses (Vorsorgeaufwendungen) in your tax return.
